name: amtr_containment_cell
description: An AMTR (antimatter) core wrapped in a FRAY field jacket with SPRK energizer and PSCN trigger taps -- deliberately field-based, minimal-structure containment, matching the source's own 'OSHA violation' framing.
why: 2054452 ('Antimatter containment unit') holds 1332 AMTR particles behind only 27 METL particles -- the real containment is a FRAY field (370 particles) plus SPRK energizing (226) and a PSCN trigger path (186), i.e. almost entirely field-based rather than physically shelled. No existing module handles AMTR at all. Recorded here as a single-point-of-failure pattern to avoid, not to imitate outright: builders using this module should add real structural jacketing (TTAN/INSL) around the FRAY ring, which the source did not.
source: save 2054452, AMTR core (261,170)-(363,262), 1332 particles; surrounding box composition FRAY=370 SPRK=226 PSCN=186 METL=27
